Read a metabolic cart export

Source: R/read_cart.R
read_cart.Rd

Reads the breath-by-breath export of a metabolic cart, averages it into fixed intervals and returns the tables that [MFO()] expects, in the package's internal data contract (SPEC 16). This is the only layer that knows the proprietary formats.

Usage

read_cart(
  file,
  device = NULL,
  interval = 10,
  cuts = NULL,
  phase = c("MFO", "basal", "graded"),
  body_mass = NULL,
  vo2_unit = c("auto", "mL/min", "L/min", "mL/kg/min")
)

Arguments

file

path of the export.

device

`NULL` (detected by spiro), `"cortex"`, `"cosmed"`, `"vyntus"` or `"zan"`.

interval

length of the averaging intervals in seconds (default 10); it becomes `step_time` for [MFO()].

cuts

optional named vector of cut times in seconds, with `basal_end` and/or `MFO_end`.

phase

without `cuts`, the phase of the whole recording: `"MFO"` (default), `"basal"` or `"graded"`.

body_mass

body mass in kg, needed only when `vo2_unit = "mL/kg/min"`.

vo2_unit

unit of VO2 and VCO2 in the export: `"auto"` (default), `"mL/min"`, `"L/min"` or `"mL/kg/min"`.

Value

An object of class `MFO_cart`: a list with `db_basal`, `db_MFO`, `db_graded` (data frames with `Time`, `VO2`, `VCO2`, `RER` and, when the export has them, `HR`, `Load`, `VE`; `NULL` for a phase not in the file), `step_time` (= `interval`) and `info` (device, interval, VO2 unit, cuts, number of breaths, of intervals and of empty intervals, and the RER mismatch count, `NA` when the export has no RER).

Details

The file is parsed with `spiro::spiro_raw()` (package spiro, rOpenSci, JOSS 2023; in Suggests), which reads Cortex (MetaSoft Studio), Cosmed (Omnia, Quark CPET, K5), Vyaire Vyntus CPX (SentrySuite) and ZAN exports. MFO has validated none of these devices with a real export of its own yet (one anonymised file per device is planned in `inst/extdata`); ZAN is tested only with the example files of spiro.

**Averaging.** The breaths are averaged in consecutive intervals of `interval` s from time 0: each value is the mean of the breaths measured in that interval, not an interpolation. An interval without breaths is kept as a row of `NA`, so the records stay aligned in time (`MFO()` cuts steps by counting records). The default of 10 s divides the usual step durations (60-300 s) and the 30-s windows of VO2max and ramps exactly, so they need no rounding.

**Units.** VO2 and VCO2 are returned in mL/min. With `vo2_unit = "auto"` a median VO2 above 100 is read as mL/min; at or below 100 the unit must be given, because L/min and mL/kg/min cannot be told apart reliably. RER is always VCO2/VO2 of the interval means; when the export has its own RER, a warning counts the intervals where they differ by more than 0.02. Load is passed through unconverted: declare its unit in [MFO_protocol()].

**Phases.** `cuts` gives the times (s from the start) at which the resting measure ends (`basal_end`) and the MFO test ends (`MFO_end`). With both, the recording is split into basal, MFO and graded tables; with `MFO_end` only, into MFO and graded (a single-day test, see [MFO_protocol()]); with `basal_end` only, into basal and MFO. Without `cuts`, the whole recording is the phase named in `phase`. Detecting the phases from the analyser's markers will come with each device importer.

No personal data from the file are kept: the result holds only the measured variables and technical information.

See also

[MFO()], [MFO_protocol()]

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("spiro", quietly = TRUE)) {
  # A graded test exported by a ZAN cart (example file of spiro)
  cart <- read_cart(spiro::spiro_example("zan_gxt"), phase = "graded")
  cart
  VO2max_from_test(cart$db_graded, step_time = cart$step_time)
}
#> Warning: age not given: the heart-rate criterion of VO2max is not evaluated.
#> <MFO_VO2max> VO2peak = 4727.2 ml/min (highest 30-s mean)
#>   plateau  not met        value 1655.019, threshold 150
#>   RER      not met        value 0.991, threshold 1.1
#>   HR       not evaluated  value NA, threshold 0.9
# }
